versions.notes: the camera can also follow animals and other movement when no person is in the picture (also animals the AI does not know): it must go in one direction for 2 s, swinging branches are let go, off in strong wind; once chosen the animal is followed by its look while the camera turns. Video scenarios of the simulator chosen, played, deleted and uploaded from the web page. Simulator: the camera tilt was upside down (fixed).

simulator video scenarios: a 360° video (or a normal video) instead of the drawn world - real pictures, the cameras look around in it with the servos, big videos are made smaller once, rough thermal picture (what moves is warm), optional sensor events per video second (.json next to the video).
simulation with CPU saving: the AI runs only half as often (smoother CPU load when somebody is in the picture).

Simulator 3 - updates itself (on the Pi when Motion Watch starts, on a PC when it connects: it fetches the new version from Motion Watch, checks the checksums and restarts); much more real: a distance for every pixel, light that falls off with the distance, haze and fog, ground pattern, clouds, sun, stars, better figures, lens distortion, glare; thermal picture with physics (cold clear sky, ground warmed by the sun and cooling at night, warm walls, clothes, engine).

switching the simulation off no longer starts a recording: the alarms of the simulation are forgotten and the real camera first learns its picture for 30 seconds (no recording, no alarm during that time).

simulator 2: real 3D view into a 360° world (own 360° photo possible), clock with fast time, moon and stars, rain / fog / snow, wind in the trees, cars with headlights, insects in the IR light, dew and spider web on the lens, covered camera, auto exposure and night noise, own cut-out photos as visitors, a ready-made night test.
the simulator is inside Motion Watch (signed with it): «Install simulator» puts it on the Pi with a menu entry and a desktop icon, «Start» / «Stop» runs it on the Pi; «Download (ZIP)» for a PC.

simulator connection: one button (quick switch «Simulation», F9 in the window) switches to a separate simulation program (motionwatch_simulator.py): its two cameras and thermal camera become the sources, Motion Watch sends servos, lights, relays and sound, and takes day / night, temperature, pressure, wind and sensor events from it. Switching off brings the real cameras back.
UPS HAT (E): the state register read as in the Waveshare register manual (bit 7 charging, bit 6 fast charging, bit 5 power at the input); the chip is recognised by its ID (0x0A).

when Motion Watch starts in the background (autostart), a small message appears on the Pi's desktop with the address of the page (waits for the desktop after booting; can be switched off under Setup).
